tcg.title: One Piece Card Game Roronoa Zoro PRB02-006 ROUND 1 Collab Japanese No.2
tcg.about: Roronoa Zoro PRB02-006 (Rare) from the Japanese ONE PIECE Card Game Premium Booster PRB02, in the ROUND 1 x ONE PIECE collaboration design. A Blocker character with +2000 counter and the Supernova / Straw Hat Crew features. The seller opened it and sleeved it right away and reports no conspicuous scratches or whitening; the photos show the front, the back and close-ups of the edges, with no whitening, folds or dents visible. Offered as a single card.
tcg.why: A Japanese Roronoa Zoro PRB02 card in the ROUND 1 collaboration design.
tcg.perfect: One Piece card collectors who want this card.
